summary: @paulgp I have seen (and been part of) the most well intentioned accidental dogpiles from #IndieWeb community. Many may never go to Twitter but see a bot pick up a tweet and throw it into IRC or we all follow the same twitter account in our readers. A flood of decontextual "help" sometime happens
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @paulgp I have seen (and been part of) the most well intentioned accidental dogpiles from #IndieWeb community. Many may never go to Twitter but see a bot pick up a tweet and throw it into IRC or we all follow the same twitter account in our readers. A flood of decontextual "help" sometime happens
